title: Maximum Sum Score of Array
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n, find the index where the maximum of the sum of the first i+1 elements and the sum of the last n-i elements is achieved.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n, find the index where the maximum of the sum of the first i+1 elements and the sum of the last n-i elements is achieved. Return this maximum sum.
constraints: For every index i, compare the prefix sum nums[0:i+1] with the suffix sum nums[i:n].
The shared value nums[i] belongs to both sums independently.
Return the largest of all prefix and suffix scores, including negative arrays.
hints: Maintain one running prefix and derive each inclusive suffix from the total.
After adding nums[i] to prefix, suffix is total-prefix+nums[i].
Update the maximum with both prefix and suffix at every index, starting from negative infinity.
The scan evaluates exactly the two scores defined for every index, so their maximum is the required result.
editorial: The scan evaluates exactly the two scores defined for every index, so their maximum is the required result.

tests.explanation: The largest considered prefix or suffix sum is ten.
The best score is the one-element prefix -3 rather than an empty sum.
